answer: Locks are entered in vertex, expire in gale, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An copycat running 110 aliases therefore needs 10 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2080 identities would post 4068 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
